title: Second parlay study done (21,425 graded requests over four days, not only the ones that traded). Findings: (1) the class we quote earns the maker +9.0% of pot at the market's price, but once linked legs are counted that is only 1.7 spreads above luck: my best estimate is about +2.3% of pot, so expect small profit with big swings. (2) The shapes are confirmed: 3-leg parlays are lost by the maker even on unselected data (buyers win 36% vs our 26% fair), legs over 80% lose, and our fair runs low on favourites, which is why sharps win there. (3) The wallet is the limit: we could win about 430 of these a day but $145 funds 10-13, so quality per dollar of collateral matters more than volume. (4) Lead time matters: parlays starting within an hour earn about 0-4%, those 3-8 hours out earn +14.5%. Changes in the profile: no parlays starting within 1 hour, none with a leg more than 12 hours out, and our fair must be at least 35% (cheaper collateral per fill). Everything else I tested stays: 2 legs max, no leg over 80%, thinnest margin, concentration guards, 30% loss stop. Engine is still off. Details: research/parlay_study_2026-11-20.md
